pages.text: The $(item)Energy Core$() is a multiblock energy store. It starts as a single block and grows into a large sphere of Draconium and Redstone blocks as you raise its tier.$(br2)Energy goes in and out through $(l:energy_core/pylons)Energy Pylons$(/l), and the core only works while it is held in place by $(l:energy_core/stabilizers)Stabilizers$(/l).
Start here: place the core where the middle of the finished build should be.
Energy is measured in OP, which converts 1:1 with FE.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: $(li)Tier 1: 45.5 million OP$(li)Tier 2: 273 million OP$(li)Tier 3: 1.64 billion OP$(li)Tier 4: 9.88 billion OP$(li)Tier 5: 59.3 billion OP$(li)Tier 6: 356 billion OP$(li)Tier 7: 2.14 trillion OP$(li)Tier 8: effectively unlimited OP$(br2)Tier 8 has no practical limit; its screen lets you set an energy target just for display. Server owners can change these numbers in the DE config.
